description: Stashed-changes false-negative ACTIVE. Predicate 1 uses `git status --porcelain`, which does not report `git stash` contents. A merged+clean+stale+unlocked worktree holding a stash trips none of the five predicates -> reapable -> deleted -> stash silently destroyed. Direct violation of NFR-002 (zero false-negative ACTIVE). Stash appears nowhere in the spec.

evidence.snippet: `uncommitted_changes`: `git status --porcelain` in the worktree path returns one or more lines.

fix: Add a sixth ACTIVE predicate has_stash (`git stash list` scoped to worktree non-empty -> ACTIVE); add edge case + PROP; extend WorktreeRecord and classifyWorktree with hasStash.
